mapper.select:
SELECT a.*,
s1.skill_name AS skill1_name, s1.max_level AS skill1_max_level,
s2.skill_name AS skill2_name, s2.max_level AS skill2_max_level,
s3.skill_name AS skill3_name, s3.max_level AS skill3_max_level,
s4.skill_name AS skill4_name, s4.max_level AS skill4_max_level
FROM armor a
LEFT JOIN skill s1 ON a.skill1_id = s1.skill_id
LEFT JOIN skill s2 ON a.skill2_id = s2.skill_id
LEFT JOIN skill s3 ON a.skill3_id = s3.skill_id
LEFT JOIN skill s4 ON a.skill4_id = s4.skill_id
ORDER BY a.part, a.armor_name

SELECT a.*,
s1.skill_name AS skill1_name, s1.max_level AS skill1_max_level,
s2.skill_name AS skill2_name, s2.max_level AS skill2_max_level,
s3.skill_name AS skill3_name, s3.max_level AS skill3_max_level,
s4.skill_name AS skill4_name, s4.max_level AS skill4_max_level
FROM armor a
LEFT JOIN skill s1 ON a.skill1_id = s1.skill_id
LEFT JOIN skill s2 ON a.skill2_id = s2.skill_id
LEFT JOIN skill s3 ON a.skill3_id = s3.skill_id
LEFT JOIN skill s4 ON a.skill4_id = s4.skill_id
WHERE a.part = #{part}
ORDER BY a.armor_name

SELECT a.*,
s1.skill_name AS skill1_name, s1.max_level AS skill1_max_level,
s2.skill_name AS skill2_name, s2.max_level AS skill2_max_level,
s3.skill_name AS skill3_name, s3.max_level AS skill3_max_level,
s4.skill_name AS skill4_name, s4.max_level AS skill4_max_level
FROM armor a
LEFT JOIN skill s1 ON a.skill1_id = s1.skill_id
LEFT JOIN skill s2 ON a.skill2_id = s2.skill_id
LEFT JOIN skill s3 ON a.skill3_id = s3.skill_id
LEFT JOIN skill s4 ON a.skill4_id = s4.skill_id
WHERE a.armor_id = #{armorId}
